description.zh: 幂等 Token。用于保证重复请求不会重复执行同一操作。
description.en: The idempotence token. Ensures that repeated requests do not result in duplicate operations.

description.zh: 快照对应的 LSN。与 SnapshotTimestamp 二选一；传入后会基于该 LSN 创建快照。
description.en: The LSN for the snapshot. You must specify either this parameter or SnapshotTimestamp. If this parameter is specified, the snapshot is created based on the specified LSN.

description.zh: 地域 ID。用于限定查询或操作所在地域。
description.en: The region ID. Specifies the region in which to perform the operation.

description.zh: 快照时间点。与 Lsn 二选一；传入后会基于该时间点解析并创建快照。
description.en: The point in time for the snapshot. You must specify either this parameter or Lsn. If this parameter is specified, the snapshot is created based on the specified point in time.

descriptions.zh: 该接口用于基于指定时间点或 LSN 为 Supabase 项目创建快照。SnapshotTimestamp 与 Lsn 二选一；ClientToken 用于保证请求幂等。
descriptions.en: Creates a snapshot for a Supabase project based on a specified point in time or Log Sequence Number (LSN). You must specify either SnapshotTimestamp or Lsn. ClientToken is used to ensure idempotence of the request.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb create-snapshot --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --project-id spb-xxxx --snapshot-timestamp 2026-04-08T09:11:12Z --lsn 0/3522648 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
